topic: Asked to sing at the town contest
title_jp: のど{自慢|じまん}で{一曲|いっきょく}
context: Saturday 12 December: アルちゃん goes with {田中|たなか}さん and {颯太|そうた} to the {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} community hall's year-end singing contest, and the organiser asks him to sing. He modestly says yes and sings a Spanish song.
scene: Saturday. At the town's year-end singing contest with {田中|たなか}さん and {颯太|そうた}, the organiser suddenly asks you to sing.

phrases.jp: よろしければ、ご{参加|さんか}いただけませんか。
phrases.en: If you don't mind, would you take part?
phrases.note: ご〜いただけませんか: a very polite request. You'll hear it from organisers and staff.

phrases.jp: {私|わたし}なんか、まだまだです。
phrases.en: Oh, someone like me? I've got a long way to go.
phrases.note: The modest reply to praise. Also: いえいえ、とんでもないです。

phrases.jp: では、お{言葉|ことば}に{甘えて|あまえて|to accept (kindness), rely on|3}…
phrases.en: Well then, if you insist… (accepting kindly)
phrases.note: Lit. 'leaning on your words'. Use it when you accept an offer after hesitating.

phrases.jp: {大きな|おおきな}{拍手|はくしゅ|applause, clapping|3}をお{願い|ねがい}します！
phrases.en: A big round of applause, please!
phrases.note: What every MC says before and after each singer.

phrases.jp: カラオケなんて、{久しぶり|ひさしぶり}だな。
phrases.note: Noun + なんて: shows a feeling about it, here surprise.

dialogue_setting: The big room of the {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} {公民館|こうみんかん}, folding chairs, a small stage, oil heaters. The organiser comes over between singers.

dialogue.speaker: 係の人
dialogue.jp: スペインの{方|かた}ですよね。よろしければ、{大会|たいかい|contest, tournament|3}で{一曲|いっきょく|one song|3}{歌って|うたって}いただけませんか。
dialogue.en: You're the person from Spain, aren't you? If you don't mind, could you sing one song in the contest?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: えっ、{私|わたし}なんかでいいんですか。{歌|うた}、{下手|へた|bad at, poor at|4}ですよ…
dialogue.en: What, someone like me is OK? I'm bad at singing…

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: アルちゃんが{歌う|うたう}なんて、すげー！{絶対|ぜったい}{盛り上がる|もりあがる|to liven up, get exciting|4}よ！
dialogue.en: You're going to sing? So cool! Everyone's going to go wild!

dialogue.speaker: 田中さん
dialogue.jp: {演歌|えんか|enka (old-style ballads)|2}なんか{歌わんで|うたわんで|(dialect) = 歌わなくて|2}いい。{好きな|すきな}{歌|うた}でいいずら。
dialogue.en: No need to sing enka or anything. Any song you like is fine.
dialogue.note: Standard: {演歌|えんか}なんか{歌|うた}わなくていい。{好|す}きな{歌|うた}でいいでしょう。

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: では、お{言葉|ことば}に{甘えて|あまえて|to accept (kindness), rely on|3}…スペインの{歌|うた}を{歌わせて|うたわせて}いただきます。
dialogue.en: Well then, if you insist… I'll sing a Spanish song.

dialogue.speaker: 係の人
dialogue.jp: ありがとうございます！では、{三番目|さんばんめ}にお{呼び|よび|to call (someone)|4}しますね。
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Then we'll call you up third.

listening.intro: The MC opens the contest over the hall's microphone.
listening.title: のど{自慢|じまん}{大会|たいかい}

lines.jp: ただいまより、{年忘れ|としわすれ|year-end (forget-the-year)|2}のど{自慢|じまん|amateur singing contest|2}{大会|たいかい|contest|3}を{始めます|はじめます}。
lines.en: We will now begin the year-end amateur singing contest.

lines.jp: {結果|けっか}は{最後|さいご}に{発表|はっぴょう|announcement|3}します。{出場者|しゅつじょうしゃ|contestant|2}の{方|かた}は、{舞台|ぶたい|stage|3}の{横|よこ}でお{待ち|まち}ください。
lines.en: The results will be announced at the end. Contestants, please wait beside the stage.

listening.question: {結果|けっか}はいつ{発表|はっぴょう}されますか。
listening.explain: {結果|けっか}は{最後|さいご}に{発表|はっぴょう}します: the results come at the very end.

grammar.form: noun: + なんか / なんて ({私|わたし}なんか, {演歌|えんか}なんか, カラオケなんて) · plain form: + なんて ({歌|うた}うなんて, {寒|さむ}いなんて)
grammar.explanation: After a noun, なんか/なんて mean 'the likes of', making it sound small: modest about yourself ({私|わたし}なんか), dismissive about things. After a plain-form sentence, なんて shows surprise: 'to think that…!'. Careful: {君|きみ}なんか about someone else sounds rude.

examples.jp: {雪|ゆき}がこんなに{積もる|つもる}なんて、{知らなかった|しらなかった}。
examples.en: I had no idea snow could pile up this much!

examples.jp: {宿題|しゅくだい}なんか、{後|あと}でいいよ。

quiz.question: {健太|けんた}が{早起き|はやおき|getting up early|3}する＿＿、{信じられない|しんじられない|unbelievable|3}！
quiz.en: {健太|けんた} getting up early? I can't believe it!
quiz.explain: Plain verb + なんて: surprise at the whole fact.

quiz_more.question: {僕|ぼく}＿＿、まだまだ{下手|へた|bad at|4}です。
quiz_more.en: Someone like me is still bad at it.
quiz_more.explain: Noun + なんか: modest about yourself.

quiz_more.question: {雪|ゆき}の{日|ひ}にカラオケに{行く|いく}＿＿、{思わなかった|おもわなかった}。
quiz_more.en: I never thought we'd go to karaoke on a snowy day.
quiz_more.explain: After a verb use なんて, not なんか: なんて + {思|おも}わなかった = 'never imagined'.

kanji.where: The heading on the sign-up sheet taped by the stage.
kanji.breakdown: 出 go out + 場 place, stage + 者 person → 'person who goes out on stage'.
kanji.related: {出場|しゅつじょう}する = to take part (in a contest, a match).

tip.title: Praise and the modest reply
tip.body: After you sing, people will say お{上手|じょうず}ですね! even if you weren't. Don't say thank you and agree: say いえいえ、とんでもないです or {私|わたし}なんか… with a smile. Clapping along in rhythm is {手拍子|てびょうし}, and it's always welcome.

challenge.prompt: After the contest, the organiser says: 「ぜひ{来年|らいねん}も{出て|でて}ください！」 Thank her politely and say yes modestly, with なんか.
challenge.model_answer: ありがとうございます。{私|わたし}なんかでよければ、{喜んで|よろこんで|gladly|3}。
challenge.explanation: {私|わたし}なんか is the modest 'someone like me', and でよければ means 'if it's all right'. {喜|よろこ}んで ('gladly') is the polite yes. All three together sound humble but happy.
challenge.hint: {私|わたし}なんかでよければ…

vocab.note: Counter {曲|きょく} for songs: {二曲|にきょく}, {三曲|さんきょく}.
大 big + 会 meeting. Sports, speech or singing contests.
〜が{下手|へた}. Opposite: {上手|じょうず}. Saying it about yourself is normal.
Parties, matches, crowds. {盛|も}り{上|あ}がったね! = That was fun!
Sad songs of the sea, sake and lost love; loved by older people.

vocab.en: to accept kindness; to act spoiled
vocab.note: From {甘|あま}い sweet. お{言葉|ことば}に{甘|あま}えて = taking you up on it.
Humble お{呼|よ}びします = 'we'll call you'. Also 'to invite'.
{拍手|はくしゅ}する = to clap. 手 hand is inside.

kanji_study.meaning: sweet; to rely on, be indulged
kanji_study.parts: A mouth (口 opened wide) with one line inside → something sweet held on the tongue to savour.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 廿 (twenty): 甘 has a closed bottom line.

kanji_study.meaning: surface, front; to show; table, chart
kanji_study.parts: An old form of 衣 clothing with 毛 fur on top → the fur side of a coat, worn outward: surface, show.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 衣 (clothing) or 麦 (wheat): 表 has three lines across the top.

extras.title: Saying yes and no politely
extras.title_jp: {丁寧|ていねい}に{受ける|うける}・{断る|ことわる}
extras.intro: When someone offers or asks something.

items.jp: せっかくですが、{今回|こんかい}は{遠慮|えんりょ|holding back|3}しておきます。
items.en: It's kind of you, but I'll pass this time.

items.jp: いえいえ、とんでもないです。
items.note: The reply to praise or thanks.

extras.title: Karaoke words
extras.title_jp: カラオケの{言葉|ことば}

items.note: Written {十八番|じゅうはちばん}, read おはこ.

items.jp: {手拍子|てびょうし|clapping in rhythm|2}
